title: How do LLMs interpret FDT in a twin PD simulation?
excerpt:
We tested how seven LLMs apply four decision theories in a prisoner's dilemma between nearly identical copies. The models largely agreed about CDT and EDT, and all completed policy-FDT trials resulted in cooperation. But their action-FDT recommendations varied dramatically: some models almost always cooperated, while others almost always defected. We then investigated whether requested reasoning effort explained some of this disagreement.

title: Swarmish: what happens when agent swarms create language?
excerpt:
TL;DR
 1. Agent swarms are capable of building sophisticated productive languages which we dub Swarmish.
 2. Agent swarms are able to solve a multi-phase collaborative task while communicating only in Swarmish.
 3. Agent swarms are able to partially decode Swarmish from task transcripts even when given no context on the task.
 4. The amount of task context available to the decoder swarm increases ability to accurately recreate Swarmish.
